`class MultilineTextFieldNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`FieldNode<String>`](/reference/controls/fieldnode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.control.field` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MultilineTextFieldNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/control/field/MultilineTextFieldNode.java)

A field of several lines whose value is its text, wrapped in its width.

![A multiline text field whose sentence wraps on two lines; the pointer clicks it, the user goes to the end and types a third line, then erases it, and each key shows in a key badge](/captures/catalog-controls-multilinetextfieldnode.webp)

## Description

Enter starts a new line, Up and Down move the cursor between lines, and the wheel scrolls a text taller than the field by one line per notch.

## Learn more

- [Text fields](/use/learn/interactivity/text-fields/#let-the-user-type-several-lines)

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
